purpose: Technical follow-up after the released India/Africa pass; source checks and city geometry verification are recorded separately.
followupDeploymentStatus: Local continuation is validated and remains uncommitted and undeployed; it is not part of the initial release.

acceptance.note: Raw acceptance totals include Kozhikode and Thiruvananthapuram, subsequently held by expanded browser checks.

holds.Mansa: Native MAN/350 denotes two disjoint lots with inconsistent survey references; no arbitrary compound key or merge.
holds.New Delhi: Internal propertyid duplicates have valid disjoint components, but publisher-facing identity and production connectivity remain unresolved.
holds.Bihar: Three fresh selector/point checks and observed public click/report workflow did not verify a geometry route; twenty conditional cities were not newly queried.
holds.Abidjan: Observed public locality API returns HTTP 502.
holds.Angola: Shared Luanda candidate metadata is reachable; its extent excludes all eight target centers.
holds.Kozhikode: The native geometry audit passed 280 parcel IDs across nine cells, but the ordinary 25-cell browser view timed out in two consecutive loads. It retained only 15 then 23 complete cells and displayed the normal unavailable-source warning. Some same-cell retries passed; reliable expanded viewport loading remains unverified. No timeout or failure handling is weakened.
holds.Thiruvananthapuram: The native geometry audit passed 456 parcel IDs across nine cells, but the ordinary browser checks failed twice: the first view loaded 25 cells and then retained only 27 of 30 after panning; a fresh load after cooldown retained only 12 of 25 cells. Both displayed the unavailable-source warning. Keep the village research-only pending reliable expanded viewport loading under unchanged deadlines.
